response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a broad polyglot background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, C/C++, Swift, PHP), but his resume shows minimal direct evidence of Java/Kotlin expertise, no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate ecosystem experience, and no IDE internals or language tooling work — all core requirements for this role. His recent and most substantial experience is in full-stack web/TypeScript and infrastructure tooling, not JVM enterprise development.
strengths: Strong, proven track record across many complex systems and diverse tech stacks
Demonstrated software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) and mentoring/teaching ability
High seniority and long tenure at reputable companies, showing reliability and technical depth
concerns: No demonstrated depth in Java/Kotlin or JVM internals in recent roles
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise application server experience
No evidence of interest or experience in IDE internals or language tooling, a core job requirement

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling background
Broad engineering experience and craftsmanship mindset
